gloss: table clock; desk clock; mantel clock

definitions.gloss: table clock; desk clock; mantel clock
definitions.explanation: A clock designed to be placed on a table, desk, shelf, or mantelpiece, as opposed to a wall clock or wristwatch.

examples.japanese: {置時計|おきどけい}を{買|か}った。
{棚|たな}の{上|うえ}に{置時計|おきどけい}を{飾|かざ}っている。
examples.english: I have a clock displayed on the shelf.

examples.japanese: アンティークの{置時計|おきどけい}が{部屋|へや}の{雰囲気|ふんいき}に{合|あ}っている。
examples.english: The antique mantel clock suits the atmosphere of the room.

notes:
A compound of {置|お}く (to place) + {時計|とけい} (clock/watch). Refers specifically to a freestanding clock meant to sit on a surface.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {置時計|おきどけい}を{置|お}く: to place a desk clock
- {置時計|おきどけい}を{飾|かざ}る: to display a clock (as decoration)
- デジタル{置時計|おきどけい}: digital desk clock
- アンティークの{置時計|おきどけい}: antique mantel clock

RELATED WORDS:
- {掛|か}け{時計|どけい}: wall clock — a clock hung on the wall
- {腕時計|うでどけい}: wristwatch — a clock worn on the wrist
- {目覚|めざ}まし{時計|どけい}: alarm clock — a clock with an alarm function
